dsh-toolbox-web is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-296f91a7af471174139b.html
